program_name: Parque Solar Comunitario
amount_note: ministry-designed distributed generation; benefit = bill discounts
recurrence: ongoing (programme rollout, not an annual concurso)

amount_note: co-financing up to ~50% of rooftop PV + ~30% aggregate-purchase discount
notes: Households in enrolled comunas co-finance rooftop PV; municipality's role is enrolment/organising (19 comunas reported open).

funder_institution: Ministerio de Energía / Agencia de Sostenibilidad Energética (AgenciaSE, fundación de derecho privado)
program_name: Fondo de Acceso a la Energía (FAE)
program_family: Fondo de Acceso a la Energía (FAE)
eligible_actor: community/citizen org (rol público comunitario >5 yrs; not municipalities directly)
amount_note: PV up to 10 kWp; solar thermal up to 1,500 L accumulation
recurrence: sporadic (created 2014 as pilot; last call closed 20 Jul 2024)
notes: Energy access for rural/isolated/vulnerable community infrastructure. Eligible = indigenous communities, juntas de vecinos, NGOs, bomberos. Last postulación finished 2024-07-20 (ChileAtiende).
